1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de hasta 8 m de altura, de copa redondeada, hojas grandes y carnosas con nervios de color rosa, flores en racimos, poco vistosas, de color blanco, y fruto pequeño, morado cuando está maduro, que se agrupa en racimos parecidos a los de la vid. Polygonaceae, Coccoloba uvifera.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Shoebutton Tree (Coccoloba uvifera)

A shrub growing up to 8 m in height, with a rounded crown, large and fleshy leaves with rose-colored veins, flowers in clusters, inconspicuous, white in color, and small fruit that is purple when ripe, grouped in clusters similar to those of the grapevine. Polygonaceae family.
